我的生活与兴趣爱好(My Life and hobbies): 一篇关于兴趣爱好的A2短文:欧文与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the dance studio by bike. Owen and Grace had great fun there. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, the little girl chose a new doll.
They took many photos at the photo club. There are always many people at the photo club. Grace is interested in dancing. What's more, the conductor lifted the tempo.
Both of them like noodles and tea. The weather was rainy that day. Grace's birthday is in October. Writing stories makes you creative.
Owen is going to travel to Paris in October. Owen thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Owen borrowed a book about English from the supermarket.
